verdicts.why: Ep 2 has Peter assigned to the energy research division under Carla Connors at Oscorp; she questions Norman and points out the risks only when he reveals Project Monolith in ep 10.
In ep 2 Amadeus mocks Peter's claim that Mr. Osborn told him to come see him, and he is placed in robotics. The GPA bragging and the full time Oscorp job both come in ep 10.

verdicts.why: The ep 2 start is right, but Norman only explains in ep 3 that he built the internship around the four likeliest Spider-Man candidates, so that fact moves to an ep 3 stage; the gateway praise and job offer stay at ep 10.

Harry founds the Worldwide Engineering Brigade and emails Jeanne the invite, and Daredevil tells her to accept and keep an eye on Harry, all in ep 10, so the stage cannot hold from ep 1.
